description: Inspera Design System component API, derived from the TypeScript interfaces. Prop names are camelCase and case-sensitive; variant values are Capitalised.

props.name: label
props.description: The button text. Start with a verb - "Save", not "OK". With `iconOnly` it is not shown but becomes the accessible name, so it is still required.

props.name: intent
props.description: Visual role / semantic weight.

props.name: size
props.description: Height 32 / 40 / 44 (`--control-height-sm/md/lg`). Small also steps down to 14px text and a 16px icon.

props.name: leadingIcon
props.description: Material Symbols name shown before the label.

props.name: trailingIcon
props.description: Material Symbols name shown after the label. Use `expand_more` for a menu trigger.

props.name: iconOnly
props.description: Show only the icon (`leadingIcon`, else `trailingIcon`); `label` becomes the accessible name.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks interaction and dims the button.

props.name: type
props.description: Native button type. Defaults to `button`, so a Button never submits a form by accident.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Fired on click and on Enter or Space.

ariaNotes: Icon-only buttons must have an accessible label

do: Use Primary for the main action
Use Secondary for an alternative to the main action
Use Destructive only for actions that delete data or cannot be undone
dont: Do not create a separate component for each intent - set the intent prop
Do not use deprecated alias names

variants.when: The one main action of a page, form or dialog, such as New test or Publish. Use one per view.
An alternative to the main action, placed next to it, such as Save draft beside Next or Publish.
A standalone action on the content around it, such as Export in a table toolbar.
A low-emphasis action: Cancel in a form footer, View all in a card header.
A positive decision, such as approving a candidate's request for more time. Keep the way to decline beside it.
An action with consequences that can be undone, such as pausing a candidate's test.
An action that deletes data or cannot be undone, such as deleting a test. Say what will be lost next to it.
Dense areas such as table rows, toolbars and filter bars, next to Small inputs.
One prominent call to action, such as Start test, or a touch-first screen. Not a whole row of buttons.

props.name: label
props.description: Field label. Always required: it is the accessible name even when hidden.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Hint shown when empty. Not a substitute for the label.

props.name: value
props.description: Current value. Controlled - pair with onChange.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Starting value when uncontrolled.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fired with the new value on every keystroke.

props.name: size
props.description: Control height.

props.name: leadingIcon
props.description: Material Symbols name shown before the text.

props.name: trailingIcon
props.description: Material Symbols name shown after the text. Decorative only.

props.name: showLabel
props.description: Render the visible label. When false, the label becomes `aria-label`.

props.name: helpText
props.description: Guidance shown below the field. Replaced by errorText when `error` is set.

props.name: errorText
props.description: Validation message, shown while `error` is true.

props.name: error
props.description: Marks the field invalid: red border, `aria-invalid`, errorText shown.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks editing and dims the field.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Shows the value without allowing edits.

ariaNotes: Always associate the label with the input using htmlFor/id
Link error text with aria-describedby
Required fields must use aria-required

do: Always include a visible label
Use placeholder text only as an example of the expected input
Show error messages below the input
dont: Do not use the placeholder as the label
Do not disable an input without saying why

variants.when: Forms and settings. The default size.
Dense areas such as table toolbars, filter bars and side panels.
The value is invalid. Say what to fix in errorText, under the field.
The value matters but cannot be changed here, such as the code of a published test. It can still be selected and copied.
The field does not apply right now. Say nearby what makes it available.

props.name: label
props.description: Text beside the box. Required: it is the accessible name even when hidden.

props.name: checked
props.description: Checked state. Controlled - pair with onChange.

props.name: defaultChecked
props.description: Starting checked state when uncontrolled.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fired with the new checked state.

props.name: indeterminate
props.description: Partially-selected state, for a parent whose children are mixed. Wins over `checked` visually and announces as mixed.

props.name: withLabel
props.description: Render the label text. When false, the label becomes `aria-label`.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks interaction and dims the control.

props.name: error
props.description: Marks the control invalid: a red border, checked or not, and `aria-invalid` on the input.

props.name: description
props.description: A line under the label: what the option does, or why it is unavailable. Shown with a visible label, and linked to the box with `aria-describedby`.

props.name: errorText
props.description: Replaces the description while `error` is set. Say what to do: "Confirm the marks to submit them."

ariaNotes: Use aria-checked to reflect state
Group related checkboxes with fieldset and legend
The description or errorText under the label is linked with aria-describedby

do: Use when people can choose more than one option
Always provide a label for each checkbox
Group related options together
Say why a disabled option is unavailable in its description, right under it
Say what to do in errorText, under the box: "Confirm the marks to submit them"
dont: Do not use for mutually exclusive options - use Radio Group instead
Do not use without a label

variants.when: A select-all box when only some of the rows are selected.
The row already names it, such as a question in a selection list. Keep the label for screen readers.
A required tick is missing, such as confirming that marks are final. Say what to do right under it.
The option does not apply right now. Say under it what makes it available.

props.name: label
props.description: Text beside the control. Required: it is the accessible name even when hidden.

props.name: selected
props.description: Selected state. Controlled - pair with onChange.

props.name: defaultSelected
props.description: Starting selected state when uncontrolled.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fired when this option becomes selected.

props.name: name
props.description: Shared form name. Every radio in a group must use the same value. Left unset, each radio gets its own generated name and stands alone.

props.name: withLabel
props.description: Render the label text. When false, the label becomes `aria-label`.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks interaction and dims the control.

props.name: error
props.description: Marks the control invalid: a red ring, selected or not, and `aria-invalid` on the input.

props.name: description
props.description: A line under the label: what the option means, or why it is unavailable. Shown with a visible label, and linked to the radio with `aria-describedby`. An error belongs to the group (Radio Group's `errorText`), not to one option.

ariaNotes: Use role="radiogroup" for the group container
Use aria-checked to indicate selected state
Arrow keys navigate between options in the group
The description under the label is linked with aria-describedby

do: Use for mutually exclusive options
Always group inside a radiogroup
Pre-select a sensible default
Give an option a description when it needs a line of its own, such as why it is unavailable
dont: Do not use when people can choose more than one option - use Checkbox instead
Do not use a single radio button on its own

variants.when: Each option needs a description or content of its own under it, so the options are laid out one by one. Otherwise use Radio Group.
The row next to it names the option, such as a template in a list. Keep the label for screen readers.
No option is chosen and one is required. Mark every option in the set and say what to choose.
One option can't be chosen here. Say why under it.

Select.purpose: Select one option from a list.

props.name: label
props.description: Field label. Always required: it is the accessible name even when hidden.

props.name: options
props.description: The choices, in display order. Plain strings when value and label match.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown when nothing is selected. Not a substitute for the label.

props.name: value
props.description: Selected value. Controlled - pair with onChange.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Starting value when uncontrolled.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fired with the selected value.

props.name: widthMode
props.description: `Fixed` is 220px wide; `Hug` fits the selected text.

props.name: showLabel
props.description: Render the visible label. When false, the label becomes `aria-label`.

props.name: search
props.description: Adds a filter box at the top of the list.

props.name: helpText
props.description: Guidance shown below the field. Replaced by errorText when `error` is set.

props.name: errorText
props.description: Validation message, shown while `error` is true.

props.name: error
props.description: Marks the field invalid: red border, `aria-invalid`, errorText shown.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks interaction and dims the field.

ariaNotes: Use aria-expanded to indicate open state
Use aria-activedescendant for highlighted option
Support arrow key navigation through options

do: Use for 5+ options where space is limited
Always provide a label
Show a clear placeholder when no option is selected
dont: Do not use for fewer than 3 options - use Radio Group instead
Do not nest selects inside other selects

variants.when: Forms. The trigger keeps one width (220px) whatever is chosen, so the form does not shift as values change.
Toolbars and filter bars, where the trigger is only as wide as its value.
Long lists, roughly 10 options or more, so people can type to narrow them.
A required choice is missing. Say what to choose in errorText.

Toggle.purpose: Switch a setting on or off instantly.

props.name: label
props.description: Text describing the setting. Required: it is the accessible name even when hidden.

props.name: checked
props.description: On / off state. Controlled - pair with onChange.

props.name: defaultChecked
props.description: Starting state when uncontrolled.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fired with the new on/off state.

props.name: size
props.description: Track / thumb size.

props.name: withLabel
props.description: Render the label text. When false, the label becomes `aria-label`.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks interaction and dims the control.

props.name: description
props.description: A line under the label: what the setting does, or why it is locked. Shown with a visible label, and linked to the switch with `aria-describedby`.

ariaNotes: Use role="switch" for the toggle
Use aria-checked to reflect on/off state
Space key toggles the switch
The description under the label is linked with aria-describedby

do: Use for settings that take effect immediately
Provide a clear label describing the setting
Show the current state visually
Say what the setting does, or why it is locked, in its description
dont: Do not use for choices that only apply when a form is submitted - use Checkbox instead
Do not hide the label unless the row already names the setting

variants.when: Settings pages, one setting per row. The default size.
Dense lists, such as settings in a side panel.
The row already names the setting, with the switch at the end of the row, as in a settings list. Keep the label for screen readers.
The setting is locked, for example by an admin policy. Say why next to it.

Card.purpose: Group related content in a contained surface.

props.name: title
props.description: Heading for the card. Also the accessible name of an interactive card.

props.name: body
props.description: Short body copy. For anything richer, pass children instead.

props.name: elevation
props.description: Surface treatment.

props.name: padding
props.description: Internal padding (12 / 16 / 24).

props.name: interactive
props.description: The whole card becomes one click target: it lifts on hover, sinks when pressed and takes a focus ring.

props.name: selected
props.description: Selected state. Controlled - pair with onSelectedChange. Setting it makes the card a toggle: interactive, and selected or not with each click.

props.name: defaultSelected
props.description: Starting selection when uncontrolled. Also makes the card a toggle.

props.name: onSelectedChange
props.description: Fired with the new selection when the card is clicked.

props.name: children
props.description: Card contents. Replaces title and body.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Fired when an interactive card is activated.

ariaNotes: An interactive card is an article with one button stretched over it, named by the title
A selectable card is a toggle: its button carries aria-pressed, and the selected tick is a second cue besides the border colour
Non-interactive cards use role="article" or a semantic section

do: Use to group related content
Maintain consistent padding within a view
Use raised elevation for primary content cards
dont: Do not nest cards inside other cards
Do not use an empty card just for layout

variants.when: Cards that lead a page on the grey canvas, such as what to continue on the home page.
Page content on the grey canvas, such as the summaries on a test's overview. No shadow, so it stays quiet.
Cards on a white page, where a shadow would be heavy, such as tests in the Cards view.
Dense grids and side panels, where many cards share the space.
A card with one main message that needs room to read, such as a summary before publishing.
The whole card opens one thing, such as a question type to start from. Put no other buttons or links inside it.
People pick options laid out as cards, such as the question types to add to a set. Each click selects or clears the card.

Badge.purpose: Display a short status label or count.

props.name: label
props.description: The badge text. One or two words.

props.name: intent
props.description: Semantic colour.

props.name: size
props.description: Height 20 / 24.

props.name: withIcon
props.description: Show a leading status icon.

props.name: icon
props.description: Material Symbols name shown before the label when withIcon is set.

ariaNotes: Use aria-label for icon-only badges
Use role="status" for dynamic count badges

do: Use for status indicators and counts
Keep labels short - 1 to 2 words
Use each intent for the same meaning everywhere
dont: Do not use for long text
Do not make badges interactive - use Tag or Button

variants.when: A status with no judgement, such as Draft or Archived.
Something upcoming or for information, such as Scheduled.
A good or finished state, such as Live or Graded.
Needs attention soon, such as Needs grading.
Something has gone wrong, such as Overdue or Failed.
Next to a page or card title.
Inside dense rows, such as the status column of a table.

Avatar.purpose: Represent a user or entity with an image or initials.

props.name: name
props.description: The person's name. Gives the initials and the accessible name.

props.name: src
props.description: Photo URL. Without one - or if it fails to load - the initials show.

props.name: icon
props.description: Material Symbols name shown instead of initials, e.g. for a guest.

props.name: size
props.description: Diameter 32 / 40 / 56.

props.name: status
props.description: Presence indicator dot. Announced with the name.

ariaNotes: Provide alt text for image avatars
Use aria-label for initials and icon variants

do: Use for user profiles and participant lists
Provide meaningful alt text
Use consistent sizing within a context
dont: Do not stretch or distort avatar images
Do not use random colours - the same person always gets the same colour

variants.when: Dense rows, such as who wrote each comment in a thread.
Lists and request rows. The default size.
The header of a page or panel about one person, such as a candidate's details.
The person is available now, such as a grader you could hand a script to. Say it in words beside it.
The person is not connected. Say since when, such as Last seen 14:02.
The person is busy with something others have to wait for, such as marking the script you opened.

props.name: message
props.description: Supporting detail. Keep it to one or two sentences.

props.name: title
props.description: Short headline stating what happened. Optional.

props.name: intent
props.description: Severity and colour. Warning and Error interrupt screen readers; Info and Success wait.

props.name: background
props.description: Tinted fill; false draws a left accent bar on a clear background.

props.name: actionLabel
props.description: Label for an inline action link, e.g. "View details". Shown when set.

props.name: onAction
props.description: Fired when the inline action is activated.

props.name: dismissible
props.description: Show a close button. Pair with onClose.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Fired when the close button is activated.

ariaNotes: Error and Warning announce as role="alert"; Info and Success as a polite role="status" - never both on one element, since role="alert" already implies assertive
Close button must have aria-label="Close alert"

do: Use for messages about the content around them
Match the intent to how serious the message is
Keep alert text concise
dont: Do not stack more than 2 alerts in the same area
Do not use alerts for permanent content

variants.when: Context people need before they act, such as grading still being in progress.
Confirms an outcome that stays relevant on the page, such as a published test. For a passing confirmation, use Snackbar.
A problem that does not block progress but needs attention, such as candidates who have not started.
Something blocks the whole form or section. Say what to fix; field errors still go on the fields.

Dialog.purpose: Present content or actions that require user attention.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the dialog is shown. Controlled - pair with onClose.

props.name: title
props.description: Dialog heading. Also the accessible name.

props.name: children
props.description: Dialog content.

props.name: size
props.description: Panel width 480 / 640. Medium for a question or confirmation, Large for a summary or short form to check first.

props.name: hasCloseButton
props.description: Show the header close button.

props.name: hasActions
props.description: Show the footer action buttons.

props.name: confirmLabel
props.description: Label for the confirming action. Name the action - "Delete", not "OK".

props.name: confirmIntent
props.description: The confirming button's intent. Destructive when the action deletes something or cannot be undone.

props.name: cancelLabel
props.description: Label for the dismissing action.

props.name: footerStart
props.description: Short text at the start of the footer, before the actions - what confirming will do, such as "2 filters set". Not for a second action.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Fired on the close button, Cancel, the scrim, and Escape.

props.name: onConfirm
props.description: Fired when the confirming action is activated.

ariaNotes: Use role="dialog" with aria-modal="true"
Set aria-labelledby to the dialog title
Trap focus inside the dialog when open
Return focus to trigger element on close
Escape key closes the dialog

do: Use for confirmations and critical decisions
Always provide a way to close the dialog
Keep dialog content focused and concise
Set confirmIntent="Destructive" when confirming deletes something or cannot be undone, and name the action: "Delete assessment"
Use footerStart for a short status of what confirming will do, such as "2 filters set"
dont: Do not open dialogs from other dialogs
Do not put a second action in footerStart - it is for text only
Do not use for non-blocking information - use Alert instead

variants.when: A question or a confirmation, such as releasing results or pausing a test. The default.
A confirmation with a summary or a short form to check first, such as the settings before publishing.
Confirming moves something forward, such as releasing results. Name the action on the button.
Confirming deletes something or can't be undone, such as deleting a test. Name the object and say what will be lost.
The dialog only shows information, such as keyboard shortcuts. The close button is the way out.

Snackbar.purpose: Show brief, non-blocking feedback at the bottom of the screen.

props.name: message
props.description: What happened. One short sentence.

props.name: intent
props.description: Accent icon colour.

props.name: actionLabel
props.description: Label for an inline action, typically "Undo". Shown when set.

props.name: onAction
props.description: Fired when the inline action is activated.

props.name: dismissible
props.description: Show a close button. Pair with onClose.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Fired when the close button is activated.

ariaNotes: Use role="status" with aria-live="polite"
Action button must be focusable
Auto-dismiss timing must be generous (5s minimum)

do: Use for brief confirmation messages
Include an undo action when appropriate
Limit to one snackbar at a time
dont: Do not use for critical errors - use Alert or Dialog instead
Do not stack multiple snackbars

variants.when: A routine change just happened, such as Draft saved. The default.
Something people may want to know now, such as a newer version being available.
A task just finished, such as moving a question. Offer Undo when it can be undone.
Something is not quite right, but work can go on, such as being offline while changes are kept.
An action failed and can be tried again, such as Couldn't save. Put Try again on it.

ToastProvider.purpose: Show brief notifications by calling toast() from anywhere in the app.

props.name: position
props.description: Where the stack anchors on screen.

props.name: max
props.description: Most toasts on screen at once. Past it, the oldest is dismissed.

ariaNotes: The stack is a role="region" labelled "Notifications" with aria-live
Each toast is announced when it appears
Action and dismiss buttons are focusable

do: Mount ToastProvider once near the app root
Call toast() for brief, dismissible feedback
Keep errors on screen longer, or until dismissed
dont: Do not use for blocking confirmation - use Dialog
Do not stack more toasts than the screen can show

variants.when: Most screens. Away from the page title and its main action. The default.
Screens with a panel on the right, such as the question settings in Author.
Screens with a bar fixed to the bottom, such as the step footer of New test.
Touch screens and narrow windows, such as Monitor on an iPad.

CommandPalette.purpose: Search and run commands from a keyboard-driven overlay.

props.name: commands
props.description: The commands to search.

props.name: open
props.description: Open state. Controlled - pair with onOpenChange.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Open initially, when uncontrolled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Fired when the open state should change.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Fired with the chosen command.

props.name: hotkey
props.description: Bind Cmd/Ctrl+K to toggle the palette. Mount one palette with this per page. Ignored while focus is in a textarea or rich-text editor, which often use the same shortcut.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Search field placeholder.

props.name: emptyText
props.description: Shown when nothing matches.

ariaNotes: Panel is a role="dialog" with aria-modal
The list uses role="listbox" and items role="option"
Cmd/Ctrl+K toggles it; Up / Down / Enter navigate and run

do: Group commands by section
Bind a discoverable hotkey (Cmd/Ctrl+K)
Filter commands as the user types
dont: Do not make it the only way to reach main navigation
Do not leave focus inside it after it closes

variants.when: Ctrl or Cmd K opens it from anywhere, for people who move around the product a lot. Show the shortcut where it can be opened.
Ctrl or Cmd K already does something on the page, such as inserting a link in the question editor. Open the palette from a button instead.

Tooltip.purpose: Provide contextual help on hover or focus.

props.name: content
props.description: The hint text. Keep it short; never put essential information here alone.

props.name: children
props.description: The element the tooltip describes: one focusable element, e.g. an icon-only Button. It receives `aria-describedby` pointing at the tooltip.

props.name: placement
props.description: Preferred side. It flips when there is no room.

props.name: theme
props.description: Surface colour.

props.name: variant
props.description: Accessibility uses larger text and more padding.

ariaNotes: Use role="tooltip" on the tooltip element
Link trigger and tooltip with aria-describedby
Escape key dismisses the tooltip
Tooltip must not contain interactive content

do: Use for supplementary information
Keep tooltip text short and scannable
Place it so it is not cut off at the edge of the screen
dont: Do not put critical information only in tooltips
Do not use for interactive content - use Popover instead

variants.when: Most tooltips, above the control, such as icon buttons in a toolbar. The default.
Controls near the top of the screen, such as icon buttons in the page header.
Controls on the left of the screen, such as a flag at the end of a row in a narrow list.
Controls at the right edge, such as the last icon on a table row.
Dark surfaces, such as the navy tool rail of the question set editor, where a dark bubble would disappear.
A longer explanation, such as what a statistical term means, in larger text that is easier to read.

props.name: items
props.description: The tabs, in order.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual treatment.

props.name: size
props.description: Tab height 40 / 48.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Stretch tabs to fill the row.

props.name: value
props.description: Active tab's value. Controlled - pair with onChange.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Starting tab when uncontrolled. Defaults to the first.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fired with the newly selected tab's value.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the tab list for assistive tech, when no heading does.

ariaNotes: Use role="tablist" on the tab container
Each tab uses role="tab" with aria-selected
Tab panels use role="tabpanel" linked by aria-labelledby
Arrow keys navigate between tabs

do: Use to organise related content sections
Label tabs clearly and concisely
Use a maximum of 6 tabs per set
dont: Do not use tabs for sequential steps - use Stepper instead
Do not nest tab sets inside other tab sets

variants.when: Sibling views of one thing, right under its title, such as a test's Overview, Candidates and Settings.
A compact switch inside a panel, such as the rubric and the marking guide beside a response.
Inside cards and panels, such as the views of a chart.
A narrow panel, where the tabs share its width, such as Questions and Resources in the question set editor.

Breadcrumb.purpose: Show the user's current location in a hierarchy.

props.name: items
props.description: Trail from root to current page. The last entry is the current page and is not a link.

props.name: separator
props.description: Divider glyph between items.

props.name: size
props.description: Text size 14 / 16.

props.name: onNavigate
props.description: Fired with the index of a crumb without an href, for client-side routing.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the navigation landmark.

ariaNotes: Wrap in nav with aria-label="Breadcrumb"
Use an ordered list for semantic structure
Mark current page with aria-current="page"

do: Use where pages sit in a hierarchy
Always include the current page as the last item
Keep breadcrumb labels concise
dont: Do not use for flat navigation
Do not make the current page a link

variants.when: Pages in a hierarchy, in the location bar or above a page title. The default.
A path of folders, such as where a question is saved in the question bank.
The location bar under the product's top bar.

props.name: label
props.description: Field label. Always required: it is the accessible name even when hidden.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Hint shown when empty. Not a substitute for the label.

props.name: value
props.description: Current value. Controlled - pair with onChange.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Starting value when uncontrolled.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fired with the new value on every keystroke.

props.name: rows
props.description: Visible text rows.

props.name: size
props.description: Vertical padding density.

props.name: showLabel
props.description: Render the visible label. When false, the label becomes `aria-label`.

props.name: helpText
props.description: Guidance shown below the field. Replaced by errorText when `error` is set.

props.name: errorText
props.description: Validation message, shown while `error` is true.

props.name: error
props.description: Marks the field invalid: red border, `aria-invalid`, errorText shown.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks editing and dims the field.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Shows the value without allowing edits.

props.name: maxLength
props.description: Maximum character length.

props.name: showCount
props.description: Show a character counter.

ariaNotes: Always associate the label with the textarea using htmlFor/id
Link error text with aria-describedby
aria-invalid reflects the error state

do: Always include a visible label
Use rows to hint expected length
Show a character counter when a max length applies
dont: Do not use for single-line input - use Text Input instead
Do not turn off resizing without a reason

variants.when: Forms and settings. The default size.
Dense panels, such as a comment under each criterion while marking.
There is a length limit people need to watch, such as a message to candidates' screens. Set maxLength with it.
The text is required or invalid. Say what to fix in errorText, such as a marking guide that AI-supported marking needs.
The text matters but can no longer change here, such as feedback once marks are confirmed. It can still be selected and copied.
The field does not apply yet. Say what makes it available, such as choosing Custom message.

FormField.purpose: Lay out a label, control and help or error text consistently around any input.

props.name: label
props.description: Field label text.

props.name: helpText

Slider.purpose: Select a numeric value from a continuous range.

props.name: label
props.description: What is being adjusted. Required: it is the accessible name even when hidden.

props.name: min
props.description: Minimum value.

props.name: max
props.description: Maximum value.

props.name: step
props.description: Increment granularity.

props.name: value
props.description: Current value. Controlled - pair with onChange.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Starting value when uncontrolled. Defaults to the midpoint.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fired as the value changes, by drag or arrow key.

props.name: formatValue
props.description: Formats the shown value and what assistive tech announces, e.g. `(v) => v + '%'`.

props.name: showValue
props.description: Show the current value.

props.name: showLabel
props.description: Render the visible label. When false, the label becomes `aria-label`.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks interaction and dims the control.

ariaNotes: Use role="slider" with aria-valuemin / aria-valuemax / aria-valuenow
Provide an accessible label via aria-label
Arrow keys adjust the value

do: Use for adjustable numeric ranges
Show the current value for precision
Provide a clear label
dont: Do not use for exact numeric entry - use Number Input instead
Do not use without min/max bounds

variants.when: People set a level they need to know exactly, such as a similarity threshold.
Only the position matters, such as playback volume.
Something next to it already says what it is, such as a zoom icon in a viewer toolbar. The label still names it for screen readers.
The setting depends on another one that is off. Say which under it.

Show the active segment clearly

Card headers and dense toolbars, such as the period of a dashboard card.
A narrow panel, where the segments share its width, such as the device in a preview panel.
The views are not available yet. Say why next to it.

Provide clear month navigation
dont: Do not use for free-form date typing without validation

State accepted file types and size limits
Give visible drag feedback
dont: Do not hide the option to browse
Do not leave out the accepted file types and size limit

variants.when: One file, which a new upload replaces, such as invigilator instructions.
Several files that go together, such as resources for a question set. List the files under the drop zone.
The file can't be used. Say why and what to upload instead.
Uploading isn't possible here, such as for someone who doesn't own the test. Say why.

props.name: label

Each option is a checkbox with aria-checked
Group related options under a shared legend/label

Provide a group label

variants.when: Most groups. One option per line is the easiest to scan.

Rating.purpose: Capture or display a star rating.

props.name: label
props.description: What is being rated, e.g. "Question difficulty". The accessible name; not shown.

props.name: value
props.description: Current rating. Controlled - pair with onChange.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Starting rating when uncontrolled.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fired with the chosen rating; 0 when cleared. Not fired when readOnly.

props.name: max
props.description: Number of stars.

props.name: size
props.description: Star size.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Display-only: announced as "4 of 5 stars", not as a set of choices.

props.name: showValue
props.description: Show the numeric value beside the stars.

ariaNotes: Container uses role="radiogroup" with an accessible label
Each star is a radio with aria-checked and an aria-label
Arrow keys adjust the rating

do: Use for feedback and review scores
Preview the rating on hover when interactive
Use read-only mode to show an average score
dont: Do not use for precise numeric input
Do not omit accessible labels on stars

variants.when: A single rating people give in a form. The default size.
Dense lists, such as rating each question in a review.
A rating people read but cannot change, such as the average of several reviews.
The exact score matters, such as when people compare ratings down a list.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the code, e.g. "Verification code". Required: it labels the group.

props.name: length
props.description: Number of digit boxes.

props.name: value
props.description: Current code. Controlled - pair with onChange.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Starting code when uncontrolled.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fired with the digits entered so far; complete when its length equals `length`.

props.name: showLabel
props.description: Render the visible label above the boxes.

props.name: error
props.description: Marks every box invalid: red border and `aria-invalid`.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks input and dims the boxes.

ariaNotes: Each box has an aria-label "Digit N"
aria-invalid reflects the error state
Backspace moves focus to the previous box; paste distributes digits

do: Auto-advance focus as digits are entered
Support paste of the full code
Use a monospace font for even alignment
dont: Do not make people move between boxes by hand
Do not allow non-numeric characters

variants.when: The code is wrong or has expired. Say what to do next, such as check the code or send a new one.
Entry is paused, such as after too many tries. Say when people can try again.

NumberInput.purpose: Enter and adjust a numeric value with steppers.

props.name: label
props.description: Field label. Always required: it is the accessible name even when hidden.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Hint shown when empty.

props.name: value
props.description: Current value. Controlled - pair with onChange.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Starting value when uncontrolled.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fired with each committed value - valid, and within min/max.

props.name: min
props.description: Minimum allowed value. The decrease button turns off at it.

props.name: max
props.description: Maximum allowed value. The increase button turns off at it.

props.name: step
props.description: Increment applied by the steppers and arrow keys.

props.name: size
props.description: Height 32 / 40 (`--control-height-sm/md`), for the value box and both steppers.

props.name: showLabel
props.description: Render the visible label. When false, the label becomes `aria-label`.

props.name: suffix
props.description: Unit shown after the number inside the value box, e.g. "min" or "%".

props.name: helpText
props.description: Guidance shown below the field. Replaced by errorText when `error` is set.

props.name: errorText
props.description: Validation message, shown while `error` is true.

props.name: error
props.description: Marks the field invalid: red border, `aria-invalid`, errorText shown.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks editing and dims the field and both steppers.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Shows the value without allowing edits. The steppers turn off.

ariaNotes: Input carries aria-invalid in the error state
Up / Down arrows increment and decrement by step
Stepper buttons are named "Decrease <label>" and "Increase <label>" and are disabled at min / max

do: Clamp values between min and max
Show the unit as an inline suffix
Use a sensible step for the quantity
dont: Do not use for codes or IDs - use Text Input
Do not hide the steppers when precise adjustment matters

variants.when: Forms and settings. The default size.
Dense rows, such as adding time for one candidate in Monitor.
The number matters but can't change now, such as the duration of a live test.
The number is worked out from other settings, or does not apply. Say why in helpText.
The number is outside its limits. Say which range is allowed.

Combobox.purpose: Filter a list of options by typing to select one.

props.name: options

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown when nothing is typed or selected.

props.name: value
props.description: Selected value. Controlled - pair with onChange.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Starting value when uncontrolled.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fired with the chosen value (or the free text, with allowCustomValue).

props.name: showLabel
props.description: Render the visible label. When false, the label becomes `aria-label`.

props.name: allowCustomValue
props.description: Allow a typed value that matches no option to be committed.

props.name: emptyText
props.description: Text shown when no option matches the query.

props.name: helpText
props.description: Guidance shown below the field. Replaced by errorText when `error` is set.

props.name: errorText
props.description: Validation message, shown while `error` is true.

props.name: error
props.description: Marks the field invalid: red border, `aria-invalid`, errorText shown.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks interaction and dims the field.

Options use role="option" with aria-selected

Allow custom values only when free text is valid
Show an empty state when nothing matches
dont: Do not use for a handful of fixed options - use Select
Do not commit a value the user has not confirmed

variants.when: Picking one item out of hundreds by typing its name, such as a grader from all staff.

props.description: Fired when the calendar opens or closes.

props.name: placeholder

props.name: showLabel

props.name: helpText

props.name: errorText
props.description: Validation message, shown while `error` is true.

props.name: error

props.description: Column definitions.

Do not overload rows with unrelated actions

Long rosters people scan, such as all tests in Deliver.
Wide rows that people read across, such as a roster with many columns.

A card or panel with nothing in it, such as no candidates needing help.
The action is the main thing to do on the page, such as creating the first question set. The default.
Inside a panel, or beside a page that already has its main action, so the view keeps one Primary.

AvatarGroup.purpose: Show a set of users as overlapping avatars with an overflow count.

props.name: avatars
props.description: People to show, in order.

props.name: max
props.description: How many to show before collapsing the rest into "+N".

props.name: size
props.description: Avatar diameter.

ariaNotes: Wrap in a group with an aria-label describing the set
Each avatar keeps its own accessible label
The overflow chip states the hidden count

do: Use for participant and collaborator lists
Cap visible avatars and show a +N overflow
Keep sizing consistent within a context
dont: Do not show dozens of avatars inline
Do not omit the overflow count

variants.when: Dense rows, such as the graders on each test in a table.
Cards and headers, such as the graders on a test's overview. The default size.
The header of a page about one team, such as a marking committee.

Stat.purpose: Highlight a key metric with an optional trend.

props.name: label
props.description: Metric name.

props.name: value
props.description: Metric value.

props.name: delta
props.description: Change indicator text, e.g. "+8.2% vs last week". Omit when there is no comparison.

props.name: deltaIntent
props.description: Trend direction: sets the arrow, the colour and what is announced.

props.name: icon
props.description: Optional leading icon.

props.name: helpText
props.description: Optional context below the value, such as the comparison period.

ariaNotes: Associate the value with its label for screen readers
Convey the trend with text, not colour alone
Use aria-label to summarise the metric and change

do: Use for dashboard summaries
Pair a value with a clear label
Indicate trend direction with an icon and text
dont: Do not rely on colour alone for the change
Do not crowd many stats together without spacing

variants.when: The figure rose and that is good, such as a higher pass rate than last sitting. The arrow is green.
The figure fell and that needs attention, such as fewer submissions on time. The arrow is red.
No real change, or a change that is neither good nor bad. Still say it in words, such as Same as last sitting.

List.purpose: Present a vertical series of related items.

props.name: items
props.description: List rows.

props.name: divided
props.description: Show dividers between rows.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Make rows clickable.

props.name: size
props.description: Row density.

props.name: onItemClick
props.description: Fired with the item and its index. Set interactive as well.

ariaNotes: Use semantic list markup (ul / li)
Interactive rows are buttons and keyboard focusable
Provide meaningful text for each item

do: Use for settings, results, and simple records
Keep primary text scannable
Use secondary text for supporting detail
dont: Do not use for comparable tabular data - use Table
Do not make only part of a row clickable

variants.when: Lists people read item by item, such as the activity on a test. The default size.
Dense side panels, such as the candidates who need help in Monitor.
Each row opens something, such as a page of settings. The whole row is the target.
Short lists that read as one group, where whitespace separates the rows.

Progress.purpose: Show completion of an ongoing task.

props.name: label
props.description: What is progressing, e.g. "Uploading attachments". The accessible name.

props.name: variant
props.description: Bar or ring.

props.name: value
props.description: Completion percentage 0-100. Required unless indeterminate.

props.name: indeterminate
props.description: Unknown-duration animation.

props.name: size
props.description: Bar height / ring diameter.

props.name: intent
props.description: Fill colour.

props.name: showValue
props.description: Render the percentage.

ariaNotes: Use role="progressbar" with aria-valuenow / min / max
Omit aria-valuenow when indeterminate
Provide an accessible label for the task

do: Show a value when you know how far along the task is
Use indeterminate when you do not know how long it will take
Match the intent colour to the context
dont: Do not use for very short operations
Do not fake progress values

variants.when: A compact place such as a dashboard tile, where a bar would not fit beside the figure.
Work that is under way, such as marking. The default.
The work is done, such as every response marked.
The work is behind, such as marking due tomorrow with most of it left.
The work has failed or is overdue. Say what to do next.
Inside table rows and list items, with the count beside it.
One task that is the focus of the screen, such as an import.
How long it will take is not known yet, such as preparing an export.
People need the exact percentage. Prefer a count in words beside the bar, such as 12 of 40.

props.name: size
props.description: Diameter 16 / 24 / 40.

props.name: intent
props.description: Arc colour.

props.name: label
props.description: What is loading, announced to screen readers.

ariaNotes: Use role="status" with aria-live="polite"
Provide an accessible label via aria-label
Include visually hidden loading text

do: Use for short waits of unknown length
Use Inverse on dark surfaces
Say what is loading
dont: Do not use when you can show how far along it is - use Progress
Do not show several spinners at once

variants.when: Inline, beside the text it is about, such as Updating next to a roster's count.
Inside a card or panel that is updating. The default size.
A whole panel people are waiting on, such as a preview being built.
Loading that should not pull the eye, such as more of a list loading at its end.
Dark surfaces, such as a video player.

Skeleton.purpose: Show placeholder shapes while content loads.

props.name: variant
props.description: Placeholder shape.

props.name: width
props.description: Explicit width.

props.name: height
props.description: Explicit height.

props.name: lines
props.description: Number of text lines. Only applies to the Text variant.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius override. Match the shape being stood in for.

ariaNotes: Skeletons are decorative and aria-hidden
Announce the real content once loaded
Mirror the layout of the content being loaded

do: Match skeleton shapes to real content
Use on first load, so the page feels faster
Replace with content as soon as it arrives
dont: Do not leave skeletons animating indefinitely
Do not use for actions people start - use Spinner

variants.when: Lines of text that are loading, such as the rows of a list.
Blocks such as a stat tile, a chart or an image.
Avatars and other round shapes.

Popover.purpose: Show interactive content anchored to a trigger.

props.name: trigger
props.description: The element that toggles the popover - usually a Button.

props.name: content
props.description: Popover body. May hold interactive content.

props.name: title
props.description: Optional panel heading; also the panel's accessible name.

props.name: placement
props.description: Preferred side. It flips when there is no room.

props.name: open
props.description: Open state. Controlled - pair with onOpenChange.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Open on mount, when uncontrolled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Fired when the popover opens or closes.

ariaNotes: Trigger uses aria-haspopup and aria-expanded
Panel uses role="dialog"
Escape and outside-click close the popover
May contain interactive content (unlike Tooltip)

do: Use for interactive content that does not fit inline
Anchor it to the element that opens it
Close it on Escape and on a click outside
dont: Do not use for simple hover hints - use Tooltip
Do not stack popovers

variants.when: Under the button that opens it, such as Filters in a toolbar. The default.
Above a trigger low on the screen, such as in the bar at the foot of the marking view.
Beside an item in a list on the left, so the list stays in view.
Beside a trigger at the right edge, such as an action at the end of a table row.

Drawer.purpose: Slide a panel in from the edge of the screen.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the drawer is shown. Controlled - pair with onClose.

props.name: title
props.description: Header title. Also the accessible name.

props.name: children
props.description: Panel contents.

props.name: side
props.description: Edge it slides from.

props.name: size
props.description: Panel width 320 / 400 / 560 (height, for Bottom).

props.name: hasCloseButton
props.description: Show the header close button.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Fired on the close button, the scrim, and Escape.

ariaNotes: Use role="dialog" with aria-modal="true"
Set aria-labelledby to the drawer title
Trap focus while open and restore it on close
Escape closes the drawer

do: Use for secondary tasks and detail panels
Provide a clear close control
Return focus to the trigger on close
dont: Do not use for critical confirmations - use Dialog
Do not open multiple drawers at once

variants.when: Details of one row while the list stays in view, such as a question from the bank. The default.
Navigation and filters that belong at the left, such as a roster's saved views on a narrow screen.
Short actions on a touch screen, such as an invigilator on an iPad acting on one candidate.
A few facts or actions.
Richer detail that still belongs beside the list, such as a question preview. Never a table wider than 5 columns.
The drawer has its own way out, such as Close beside its actions, or a list where choosing an item closes it.

props.name: pageCount
props.description: Total number of pages.

props.name: page
props.description: Current page (1-based). Controlled - pair with onChange.

props.name: defaultPage
props.description: Starting page when uncontrolled.

props.name: siblingCount
props.description: Pages shown either side of current.

props.name: size
props.description: Control height.

props.name: showEdges
props.description: Show first / last controls.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fired with the requested page number, 1-based.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the navigation landmark. Give each pager on a page its own.

ariaNotes: Wrap in nav with aria-label="Pagination"
Mark the current page with aria-current="page"
Disable Previous on the first page and Next on the last

do: Use for long, paged result sets
Show current, first, and last pages
Collapse large gaps with an ellipsis
dont: Do not use for a handful of items
Do not hide the current page indicator

variants.when: Under a long list that fills the page, such as all tests. The default size.
Dense or narrow places, such as stepping through responses while marking.
Many pages, where jumping to the first or last one saves clicks.
Up to about 7 pages, when every page number is already shown.

Menu.purpose: Present a list of actions in a dropdown.

props.name: label
props.description: Trigger text. With `iconOnly` it is not shown but names the trigger and the menu, so make it specific: "Actions for Algebra Quiz", not "Actions".

props.name: items
props.description: Menu items, in order.

props.name: placement
props.description: Aligns the menu to the trigger's start or end edge.

props.name: size
props.description: Trigger height 32 / 40 (`--control-height-sm/md`). Small also steps down to 14px text and a 16px icon.

props.name: iconOnly
props.description: Show only an icon - a Text icon-only Button. The overflow trigger for table rows, card headers and toolbars.

props.name: icon
props.description: Material Symbols name for the icon-only trigger.

props.name: open
props.description: Open state. Controlled - pair with onOpenChange.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Open on mount, when uncontrolled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Fired when the menu opens or closes.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Fired with the chosen item's value (its label, unless set).

ariaNotes: Trigger uses aria-haspopup="menu" and aria-expanded
An icon-only trigger is named by label, which says what it acts on: "Actions for Ada Lovelace"
Items use role="menuitem"
Arrow keys move, Enter selects, Escape closes
Outside click closes the menu

do: Use for grouped actions and overflow
Separate destructive actions with a divider
Start item labels with a verb
dont: Do not use for selecting a value - use Select
Do not nest menus more than one level

variants.when: A trigger at the left of a toolbar, such as the actions for selected candidates. The menu lines up with its left edge.
A trigger at the right edge, such as More in a page header or the actions on a table row, so the menu opens inward.
The actions for one table row or one card, where a labelled trigger repeated on every row would crowd it. Name it for its row.
Table rows and dense toolbars, beside Small buttons and inputs.

Stepper.purpose: Show progress through a sequence of steps.

props.name: steps
props.description: Ordered steps.

props.name: activeStep
props.description: Zero-based index of the current step. Steps before it show as completed.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Layout direction.

props.name: size
props.description: Indicator size.

ariaNotes: Use an ordered list for step semantics
Mark the current step with aria-current="step"
Convey completion with an icon, not colour alone

do: Use for multi-step flows and wizards
Show completed, current, and upcoming states
Keep step labels short
dont: Do not use for non-sequential navigation - use Tabs
Do not use more than a handful of steps

variants.when: Across the top of a flow of a few steps, such as New test.
Beside the content, when each step needs a line of detail, such as what is left before a test can be published.
Inside dialogs and panels, such as importing candidates.

Link.purpose: Navigate to another location or resource.

props.name: href
props.description: Destination URL. Always a real one - use a Button for actions.

props.name: children
props.description: Link text.

props.name: label
props.description: Link text, when not passing children.

props.name: intent
props.description: Colour emphasis.

props.name: size
props.description: Text size.

props.name: underline
props.description: Underline behaviour.

props.name: external
props.description: Open in a new tab, with an icon and a spoken "opens in a new tab".

props.name: disabled
props.description: Non-interactive state.

props.name: leadingIcon
props.description: Material Symbols name shown before the text.

props.name: trailingIcon
props.description: Material Symbols name shown after the text.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Fired on activation. Use for client-side routing, not to replace href.

ariaNotes: Use a real anchor with a valid href
External links set target="_blank" and rel="noreferrer"
Disabled links set aria-disabled and prevent navigation
Focus ring is visible on keyboard focus

do: Use for navigation, not actions
Signal external links with an icon
Keep link text descriptive
dont: Do not use links to trigger actions - use Button
Do not use "click here" as link text

variants.when: Secondary links that should not compete, such as the links at the foot of a page.
Tables, captions and other 14px text, such as test titles in a roster.
Links that stand apart from other text, such as one under a card. The underline appears on hover. The default.
Links inside a sentence, where colour alone would not set them apart from the words around them.
Only where the layout already says it is a link, such as the items of a side navigation.
Opens another site in a new tab, such as a download from a supplier. The icon says so.
The page isn't available yet, such as results before marking ends. Say when it will be.
